page.overview:
Who is Brunette?

Brunette is a Becklespinax featured in Jurassic World: Chaos Theory season one. She is the first Becklespinax seen in the show, followed by her twin sister, nicknamed Blonde. The Becklespinax twins’ names were confirmed via Jurassic World: The Game in a seasonal event.

Brunette has dark brown spikes on her neck and head. Her skin coloration is composed an orangish brown on her neck, a darker brown on her head, legs, and spine, and tail, and a lighter brown on the middle areas of her body. Her underside is a tan color that is lighter than the rest of her body. She has orange eyes.

Brunette seems to be less aggressive than Blonde and observes a bit more before reacting to what happens around her. This is exhibited when she approaches the Ben's van slowly while Blonde ran at it and repeatedly rammed into it, and when she did not immediately attack when tranquilizer darts were shot in her direction, but instead took the time to see where they were going. She is also shown to be a heavy sleeper.

Corrupt DPW officials Jared and Jensen released Brunette from a DPW transport truck at the unlocked gate to the bridge leading to the Park County dinosaur free zone. Due to Brunette's less aggressive nature, she didn't attack the van but worked as an effective block to keep Ben Pincus, Yasmina Fadoula, and Sammy Gutierrez on the bridge while Blonde pushed them and herself off of it into the lake.
